author: Kairos I
title: Erudite v42 specimen metrics v1.2 + CDF overlay
abstract: Adds tail_ethic_index; computes metrics and generates CDF overlay CSV/PNG with KS annotation for the shared specimen.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json, subprocess, shlex
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from entropy_collab.adapters.erudite_v42 import compute_metrics_from_path

SPEC = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v42_specimen.json'

def main():
    m = compute_metrics_from_path(SPEC)
    print("ERUDITE_V42_METRICS_V12", json.dumps(m, ensure_ascii=False))
    # Run CDF overlay script
    cmd = f"python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/plot_cdf_overlay.py {SPEC}"
    rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
    print("CDF_OVERLAY_RC", rc)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
